prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1149; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Katy. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts, but I'm fine going on the recording. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?

A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light. I'd slowed a little because traffic was backed up on the cross street. Then a pickup came in from my right side and hit my driver's door.

Q: Did you see the pickup before it reached you?

A: Not clearly. I noticed headlights to my right, but I was focused on the car ahead of me and didn't react in time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, the whole time.

Q: What injuries did you sustain?

A: I broke my left wrist. The doctor said it was a fracture near the joint. I've had it in a splint and I'm going to a hand specialist next week. My shoulder is sore too, but the wrist is the main problem.

Q: Did you receive any treatment at the scene?

A: The paramedics checked me out and wanted me to go to the hospital. I went by ambulance and was seen the same day.

Q: Has anyone else been involved or made statements about the crash?

A: The other driver's insurer has contacted me. A passenger in the pickup was there too, but I didn't speak with her beyond exchanging information.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add or correct?

A: Only that the damage to my car was on the driver's side, and it's still at the repair shop. That's all I have.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
